name: Medallion  Vehicles - Authorized
description:
This dataset lists authorized medallion vehicles, most likely New York City taxi medallions, with one row per licensed vehicle. Each record includes the medallion license number, the licensee or company name, the DMV license plate number, and the vehicle identification number (VIN). It also captures vehicle details such as model year (ranging from 2014 to 2026) and vehicle type, where the only populated value is "WAV" (wheelchair-accessible vehicle), though that field is missing for about a third of rows. Medallion type distinguishes "Named Driver" from "Owner Must Drive" medallions, and a status field shows all sampled records as current.

Several columns describe the agent associated with the medallion, including an agent number and agent name, though these are missing for roughly a third to half of rows. Three agent contact fields (telephone, website, address) are entirely empty. The "type" column actually contains expiration dates
